text: When ultraviolet sunlight hits our skin, it affects each of us a little differently.
ipa: /wˈɛn ˌʌltɹəvˈaɪəlɪt sˈʌnlˌaɪt hˈɪts ˈaʊɚ skˈɪn ˈɪt əfˈɛkts ˈitʃ ˈʌv ˈʌs ə lˈɪtəl dˈɪfɹəntli/

text: Depending on skin color, it will take only minutes of exposure to turn one person beetroot-pink,
ipa: /dɪpˈɛndɪŋ ˈɑn skˈɪn kˈʌlɚ ˈɪt wˈɪl tˈeɪk ˈoʊnli mˈɪnəts ˈʌv ɪkspˈoʊʒɚ tˈu tˈɝn wˈʌn pˈɝsən beetrootpink/
vi: Tùy thuộc vào màu da, chỉ cần vài phút tiếp xúc là có thể khiến một người chuyển sang màu hồng củ dền,

text: while another requires hours to experience the slightest change.
ipa: /wˈaɪl ənˈʌðɚ ɹikwˈaɪɚz ˈaʊɚz tˈu ɪkspˈɪɹiəns ðə slˈaɪtəst tʃˈeɪndʒ/
vi: trong khi cái khác đòi hỏi hàng giờ để trải nghiệm sự thay đổi nhỏ nhất.

text: So what's to account for that difference,
ipa: /sˈoʊ wˈʌts tˈu əkˈaʊnt fˈɔɹ ðˈæt dˈɪfɚəns/
vi: Vậy điều gì giải thích cho sự khác biệt đó,

text: and how did our skin come to take on so many different
ipa: /ənd hˈaʊ dˈɪd ˈaʊɚ skˈɪn kˈʌm tˈu tˈeɪk ˈɑn sˈoʊ mˈɛni dˈɪfɚənt/
vi: và da của chúng ta đã có được nhiều màu sắc khác nhau như thế nào

text: hues to begin with? Whatever the color, our skin tells an epic tale of human intrepidness
ipa: /hjˈuz tˈu bɪɡˈɪn wˈɪð wˌʌtˈɛvɚ ðə kˈʌlɚ ˈaʊɚ skˈɪn tˈɛlz ˈæn ˈɛpɪk tˈeɪl ˈʌv hjˈumən intrepidness/
vi: màu sắc để bắt đầu? Dù là màu gì, làn da của chúng ta kể một câu chuyện hùng tráng về sự gan dạ của con người

text: and adaptability, revealing its variance to be a function of biology.
ipa: /ənd ədˌæptəbˈɪləti ɹɪvˈilɪŋ ˈɪts vˈɛɹiəns tˈu bˈi ə fˈʌŋkʃən ˈʌv baɪˈɑlədʒi/
vi: và khả năng thích ứng, cho thấy sự biến đổi của nó là một chức năng của sinh học.

text: It all centers around melanin, the pigment that gives skin and hair its color.
ipa: /ˈɪt ˈɔl sˈɛntɚz ɚˈaʊnd mˈɛlənən ðə pˈɪɡmənt ðˈæt ɡˈɪvz skˈɪn ənd hˈɛɹ ˈɪts kˈʌlɚ/
vi: Tất cả xoay quanh melanin, sắc tố tạo nên màu sắc cho da và tóc.

text: This ingredient comes from skin cells called melanocytes and takes two basic forms.
ipa: /ðˈɪs ˌɪnɡɹˈidiənt kˈʌmz fɹˈʌm skˈɪn sˈɛlz kˈɔld melanocytes ənd tˈeɪks tˈu bˈeɪsɪk fˈɔɹmz/
vi: Thành phần này đến từ các tế bào da gọi là tế bào hắc tố và có hai dạng cơ bản.

text: There's eumelanin, which gives rise to a range of brown skin tones,
ipa: /ðˈɛɹz eumelanin wˈɪtʃ ɡˈɪvz ɹˈaɪz tˈu ə ɹˈeɪndʒ ˈʌv bɹˈaʊn skˈɪn tˈoʊnz/

text: as well as black, brown, and blond hair, and pheomelanin,
ipa: /ˈæz wˈɛl ˈæz blˈæk bɹˈaʊn ənd blˈɑnd hˈɛɹ ənd pheomelanin/

text: which causes the reddish browns of freckles and red hair.
ipa: /wˈɪtʃ kˈɑzəz ðə ɹˈɛdɪʃ bɹˈaʊnz ˈʌv fɹˈɛkəlz ənd ɹˈɛd hˈɛɹ/

text: But humans weren't always like this. Our varying skin
ipa: /bˈʌt hjˈumənz wˈɝənt ˈɔlwˌeɪz lˈaɪk ðˈɪs ˈaʊɚ vˈɛɹiɪŋ skˈɪn/

text: tones were formed by an evolutionary process driven by the Sun.
ipa: /tˈoʊnz wˈɝ fˈɔɹmd bˈaɪ ˈæn ˌɛvəlˈuʃənˌɛɹi pɹˈɑsˌɛs dɹˈɪvən bˈaɪ ðə sˈʌn/

text: In began some 50,000 years ago when our ancestors migrated north from Africa
ipa: /ɪn bɪɡˈæn sˈʌm 50000 jˈɪɹz əɡˈoʊ wˈɛn ˈaʊɚ ˈænsˌɛstɚz mˈaɪɡɹˌeɪtɪd nˈɔɹθ fɹˈʌm ˈæfɹəkɑ/

text: and into Europe and Asia.
ipa: /ənd ˈɪntu jˈʊɹəp ənd ˈeɪʒə/

text: These ancient humans lived between the Equator and the Tropic of Capricorn, a region saturated
ipa: /ðˈiz ˈeɪntʃənt hjˈumənz lˈɪvd bɪtwˈin ðə ɪkwˈeɪtɚ ənd ðə tɹˈɑpɪk ˈʌv kˈæpɹəkɔɹn ə ɹˈidʒən sˈætʃɚˌeɪtɪd/

text: by the Sun's UV-carrying rays.
ipa: /bˈaɪ ðə sˈʌnz uvcarrying ɹˈeɪz/

text: When skin is exposed to UV for long periods of time, the UV light damages
ipa: /wˈɛn skˈɪn ˈɪz ɪkspˈoʊzd tˈu jˈuvˈi fˈɔɹ lˈɔŋ pˈɪɹiədz ˈʌv tˈaɪm ðə jˈuvˈi lˈaɪt dˈæmədʒəz/

text: the DNA within our cells, and skin starts to burn.
ipa: /ðə dˈiˌɛnˈeɪ wɪðˈɪn ˈaʊɚ sˈɛlz ənd skˈɪn stˈɑɹts tˈu bˈɝn/

text: If that damage is severe enough, the cells mutations can lead to melanoma, a deadly cancer
ipa: /ˈɪf ðˈæt dˈæmədʒ ˈɪz səvˈɪɹ ɪnˈʌf ðə sˈɛlz mjutˈeɪʃənz kˈæn lˈɛd tˈu mˌɛlənˈoʊmə ə dˈɛdli kˈænsɚ/

text: that forms in the skin's melanocytes.
ipa: /ðˈæt fˈɔɹmz ɪn ðə skˈɪnz melanocytes/

text: Sunscreen, as we know it today, didn't exist 50,000 years ago.
ipa: /sənskɹˈin ˈæz wˈi nˈoʊ ˈɪt tədˈeɪ dˈɪdənt ɪɡzˈɪst 50000 jˈɪɹz əɡˈoʊ/

text: So how did our ancestors cope with this onslaught of UV?
ipa: /sˈoʊ hˈaʊ dˈɪd ˈaʊɚ ˈænsˌɛstɚz kˈoʊp wˈɪð ðˈɪs ˈɔnslˌɔt ˈʌv jˈuvˈi/

text: The key to survival lay in their own personal sunscreen manufactured beneath the skin: melanin.
ipa: /ðə kˈi tˈu sɚvˈaɪvəl lˈeɪ ɪn ðˈɛɹ ˈoʊn pˈɝsɪnəl sənskɹˈin mˌænjəfˈæktʃɚd bɪnˈiθ ðə skˈɪn mˈɛlənən/

text: The type and amount of melanin in your skin determines whether you'll be more
ipa: /ðə tˈaɪp ənd əmˈaʊnt ˈʌv mˈɛlənən ɪn jˈɔɹ skˈɪn dətˈɝmənz wˈɛðɚ jˈul bˈi mˈɔɹ/

text: or less protected from the sun.
ipa: /ˈɔɹ lˈɛs pɹətˈɛktɪd fɹˈʌm ðə sˈʌn/

text: This comes down to the skin's response as sunlight strikes it. When
ipa: /ðˈɪs kˈʌmz dˈaʊn tˈu ðə skˈɪnz ɹɪspˈɑns ˈæz sˈʌnlˌaɪt stɹˈaɪks ˈɪt wˈɛn/

text: it's exposed to UV light, that triggers special light-sensitive receptors called rhodopsin,
ipa: /ˈɪts ɪkspˈoʊzd tˈu jˈuvˈi lˈaɪt ðˈæt tɹˈɪɡɚz spˈɛʃəl lightsensitive ɹəsˈɛptɚz kˈɔld ɹoʊdˈɑpsən/

text: which stimulate the production of melanin to shield cells from damage.
ipa: /wˈɪtʃ stˈɪmjəlˌeɪt ðə pɹədˈʌkʃən ˈʌv mˈɛlənən tˈu ʃˈild sˈɛlz fɹˈʌm dˈæmədʒ/

text: For light-skin people, that extra melanin darkens their skin and produces a tan.
ipa: /fˈɔɹ lightskin pˈipəl ðˈæt ˈɛkstɹə mˈɛlənən darkens ðˈɛɹ skˈɪn ənd pɹədˈusəz ə tˈæn/

text: Over the course of generations, humans living at the Sun-saturated latitudes in Africa adapted to have
ipa: /ˈoʊvɚ ðə kˈɔɹs ˈʌv dʒˌɛnɚˈeɪʃənz hjˈumənz lˈɪvɪŋ ˈæt ðə sunsaturated lˈætətˌudz ɪn ˈæfɹəkɑ ədˈæptɪd tˈu hˈæv/

text: a higher melanin production threshold and more eumelanin, giving skin a darker tone.
ipa: /ə hˈaɪɚ mˈɛlənən pɹədˈʌkʃən θɹˈɛʃˌoʊld ənd mˈɔɹ eumelanin ɡˈɪvɪŋ skˈɪn ə dˈɑɹkɚ tˈoʊn/

text: This built-in sun shield helped protect them from melanoma, likely making them evolutionarily fitter.
ipa: /ðˈɪs bˈɪltˌɪn sˈʌn ʃˈild hˈɛlpt pɹətˈɛkt ðˈɛm fɹˈʌm mˌɛlənˈoʊmə lˈaɪkli mˈeɪkɪŋ ðˈɛm evolutionarily fˈɪtɚ/

text: And capable of passing this useful trait on to new generations.
ipa: /ənd kˈeɪpəbəl ˈʌv pˈæsɪŋ ðˈɪs jˈusfəl tɹˈeɪt ˈɑn tˈu nˈu dʒˌɛnɚˈeɪʃənz/

text: But soon, some of our Sun-adapted ancestors migrated northward out of the tropical zone, spreading far
ipa: /bˈʌt sˈun sˈʌm ˈʌv ˈaʊɚ sunadapted ˈænsˌɛstɚz mˈaɪɡɹˌeɪtɪd nˈɔɹθwɚd ˈaʊt ˈʌv ðə tɹˈɑpɪkəl zˈoʊn spɹˈɛdɪŋ fˈɑɹ/

text: and wide across the Earth.
ipa: /ənd wˈaɪd əkɹˈɔs ðə ˈɝθ/

text: The further north they traveled, the less direct sunshine they saw.
ipa: /ðə fˈɝðɚ nˈɔɹθ ðˈeɪ tɹˈævəld ðə lˈɛs dɚˈɛkt sˈʌnʃˌaɪn ðˈeɪ sˈɔ/

text: This was a problem because although UV light can damage skin, it also has
ipa: /ðˈɪs wˈɑz ə pɹˈɑbləm bɪkˈɔz ˌɔlðˈoʊ jˈuvˈi lˈaɪt kˈæn dˈæmədʒ skˈɪn ˈɪt ˈɔlsoʊ hˈæz/

text: an important parallel benefit.
ipa: /ˈæn ˌɪmpˈɔɹtənt pˈɛɹəlˌɛl bˈɛnəfɪt/

text: UV helps our bodies produce vitamin D, an ingredient that strengthens bones
ipa: /jˈuvˈi hˈɛlps ˈaʊɚ bˈɑdiz pɹədˈus vˈaɪtəmən dˈi ˈæn ˌɪnɡɹˈidiənt ðˈæt stɹˈɛŋθənz bˈoʊnz/

text: and lets us absorb vital minerals, like calcium, iron, magnesium, phosphate, and zinc.
ipa: /ənd lˈɛts ˈʌs əbzˈɔɹb vˈaɪtəl mˈɪnɚəlz lˈaɪk kˈælsiəm ˈaɪɚn mæɡnˈiziəm fˈɑsfeɪt ənd zˈɪŋk/

text: Without it, humans experience serious fatigue and weakened bones
ipa: /wɪθˈaʊt ˈɪt hjˈumənz ɪkspˈɪɹiəns sˈɪɹiəs fətˈiɡ ənd wˈikənd bˈoʊnz/

text: that can cause a condition known as rickets.
ipa: /ðˈæt kˈæn kˈɑz ə kəndˈɪʃən nˈoʊn ˈæz ɹˈɪkɪts/

text: For humans whose dark skin effectively blocked whatever sunlight there was, vitamin D deficiency would have
ipa: /fˈɔɹ hjˈumənz hˈuz dˈɑɹk skˈɪn ɪfˈɛktɪvli blˈɑkt wˌʌtˈɛvɚ sˈʌnlˌaɪt ðˈɛɹ wˈɑz vˈaɪtəmən dˈi dɪfˈɪʃənsi wˈʊd hˈæv/

text: posed a serious threat in the north.
ipa: /pˈoʊzd ə sˈɪɹiəs θɹˈɛt ɪn ðə nˈɔɹθ/

text: But some of them happened to produce less melanin.
ipa: /bˈʌt sˈʌm ˈʌv ðˈɛm hˈæpənd tˈu pɹədˈus lˈɛs mˈɛlənən/

text: They were exposed to small enough amounts of light
ipa: /ðˈeɪ wˈɝ ɪkspˈoʊzd tˈu smˈɔl ɪnˈʌf əmˈaʊnts ˈʌv lˈaɪt/

text: that melanoma was less likely, and their lighter skin better absorbed the UV light.
ipa: /ðˈæt mˌɛlənˈoʊmə wˈɑz lˈɛs lˈaɪkli ənd ðˈɛɹ lˈaɪtɚ skˈɪn bˈɛtɚ əbzˈɔɹbd ðə jˈuvˈi lˈaɪt/

text: So they benefited from vitamin D, developed strong bones,
ipa: /sˈoʊ ðˈeɪ bˈɛnəfˌɪtɪd fɹˈʌm vˈaɪtəmən dˈi dɪvˈɛləpt stɹˈɔŋ bˈoʊnz/

text: and survived well enough to produce healthy offspring.
ipa: /ənd sɚvˈaɪvd wˈɛl ɪnˈʌf tˈu pɹədˈus hˈɛlθi ˈɔfspɹˌɪŋ/

text: Over many generations of selection, skin color in those regions gradually lightened.
ipa: /ˈoʊvɚ mˈɛni dʒˌɛnɚˈeɪʃənz ˈʌv səlˈɛkʃən skˈɪn kˈʌlɚ ɪn ðˈoʊz ɹˈidʒənz ɡɹˈædʒuəli lˈaɪtənd/

text: As a result of our ancestor's adaptability, today the planet is full of people
ipa: /ˈæz ə ɹɪzˈʌlt ˈʌv ˈaʊɚ ˈænsˌɛstɚz ədˌæptəbˈɪləti tədˈeɪ ðə plˈænət ˈɪz fˈʊl ˈʌv pˈipəl/

text: with a vast palette of skin colors, typically, darker eumelanin-rich skin in the hot, sunny band
ipa: /wˈɪð ə vˈæst pˈælət ˈʌv skˈɪn kˈʌlɚz tˈɪpɪkli dˈɑɹkɚ eumelaninrich skˈɪn ɪn ðə hˈɑt sˈʌni bˈænd/

text: around the Equator, and increasingly lighter pheomelanin-rich skin shades fanning outwards as the sunshine dwindles.
ipa: /ɚˈaʊnd ðə ɪkwˈeɪtɚ ənd ɪnkɹˈisɪŋli lˈaɪtɚ pheomelaninrich skˈɪn ʃˈeɪdz fˈænɪŋ ˈaʊtwɚdz ˈæz ðə sˈʌnʃˌaɪn dwˈɪndəlz/

text: Therefore, skin color is little more than an adaptive trait for living on a rock
ipa: /ðˈɛɹfˌɔɹ skˈɪn kˈʌlɚ ˈɪz lˈɪtəl mˈɔɹ ðˈæn ˈæn ədˈæptɪv tɹˈeɪt fˈɔɹ lˈɪvɪŋ ˈɑn ə ɹˈɑk/

text: that orbits the Sun.
ipa: /ðˈæt ˈɔɹbəts ðə sˈʌn/

text: It may absorb light, but it certainly does not reflect character.
ipa: /ˈɪt mˈeɪ əbzˈɔɹb lˈaɪt bˈʌt ˈɪt sˈɝtənli dˈʌz nˈɑt ɹɪflˈɛkt kˈɛɹɪktɚ/
